heading: Seven disciplines, one value chain.
intro: From waste collection to cultivated land, each service reinforces the next.

items.title: Biodigester construction
items.description: Masonry domes suited to tropical climates, sized to livestock and gas needs.

items.title: Agri-Shell biofertilizers
items.description: Liquid and granular biofertilizer produced from digestate and organic residue.

items.title: Biowaste management
items.description: Collection, sorting and valorization of agricultural and household residue.

items.title: Organic agriculture
items.description: Demonstration plots grown without chemical inputs, in support of farmers.

items.title: Animal production
items.description: Integrating livestock as a feedstock source for biodigesters.

items.title: Soil research
items.description: Lab analysis to ensure the quality and effectiveness of our biofertilizers.

items.title: Training & support
items.description: Certifying farmers and young people engaged in the green transition.
